item.title: ALL-STATE BASKETBALL (GIRLS): Cold Springs’ Dickerson, Good Hope’s Konrad and Davis claim 1st-team honors; other local standouts recognized by ASWA - The Cullman Times
item.description: Cold Springs’ Ella Dickerson (Class 2A), Good Hope’s Sophie Konrad (Class 4A) and Good Hope’s Ella Davis (Class 4A) secured first-team honors in their respective classifications when the Alabama Sports Writers Association, of which The Times is a voting member, announced this year’s All-State basketball teams on Saturday.
